note: Current-release digital-engine registration baseline after implementing Strategic Withdrawal through the shared pre-clear Aftermath destination flow. Current Action parity remains 74/74. Current battle parity is 82/113, leaving 31 unsupported battle surfaces. Strategic Withdrawal is an optional owner-loss effect available only after a real normal retreat when another Position toward the owner's end remains and another battle card is available to return. Its additional Position is ordinary effect movement, not a Retreat step, so Retreat-only triggers such as Landslide do not fire; the selected other Gambit, Tactic, or Reserve card returns to Hand instead of its normal battle cleanup destination. Registration remains a surface census, not a claim that every historically registered behavior has been fully revalidated against all v0.7.2 semantic changes.
